description: This file contains C# source code defining UI components and data converters for the SupplementaryResults view in a Windows UWP application. It includes classes for data conversion, template selection, custom panel behavior, and the SupplementaryResults UserControl, which displays a collection of supplementary results with specific styling and behavior.

classes.name: DelighterUnitToStyleConverter
classes.description: Converts a Unit object to a Style based on its whimsical status, using a resource dictionary.

classes.name: SupplementaryResultDataTemplateSelector
classes.description: Selects between different DataTemplates for SupplementaryResult items based on whether they are whimsical.

classes.name: SupplementaryResultNoOverflowStackPanel
classes.description: Custom StackPanel that prioritizes the last item if it is a whimsical SupplementaryResult.

classes.name: SupplementaryResults
classes.description: A UserControl that displays a collection of SupplementaryResult objects with data binding and styling.

methods.name: DelighterUnitToStyleConverter()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the resource dictionary for styles.

methods.name: Convert()
methods.description: Converts a Unit object to a Style based on its whimsical status.

methods.name: ConvertBack()
methods.description: Not implemented; asserts false as only one-way binding is supported.

methods.name: SelectTemplateCore()
methods.description: Selects the appropriate DataTemplate based on whether the SupplementaryResult is whimsical.

methods.name: ShouldPrioritizeLastItem()
methods.description: Determines if the last child should be prioritized based on its whimsical status.

methods.name: Results { get; set; }
methods.description: Property for binding the collection of SupplementaryResult objects.
